findings.title: Payment gateway timeout causes silent failure
findings.description: The payment endpoint times out 40% of the time and the user sees a blank error page with no explanation or retry option.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: POST /api/orders returns 500 with a gateway timeout error. INFERRED: The timeout threshold is set too low.
findings.recommendation: Add a payment retry mechanism and show a user-friendly error with options: retry, use another payment method, or save cart.

evidence.description: POST /api/orders returned HTTP 500 — gateway_timeout
Unhandled promise rejection: PaymentError: gateway_timeout

findings.title: Login redirects to non-existent /dashboard route
findings.description: After successful login, users are redirected to /dashboard which does not exist, resulting in a 404 error.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: The login success redirect is hardcoded to /dashboard. INFERRED: This was not updated when the dashboard route was removed.
findings.recommendation: Change the post-login redirect to /products or the user's intended destination.

evidence.description: Expected redirect to /products, got /dashboard (404)

findings.title: No visual feedback when adding item to cart
findings.description: Clicking "Add to Cart" updates the cart count but shows no toast, animation, or confirmation. Users may click multiple times thinking the action failed.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: INFERRED: The addToCart function only logs to console, with no UI notification implemented.
findings.recommendation: Add a toast notification or cart flyout when an item is successfully added.

evidence.description: Cart badge updated but no feedback shown to user
console.log: "Item added to cart: ProBook Laptop"

findings.title: Order history always empty after purchase
findings.description: Immediately after placing an order, the Order History page shows "No orders yet" — orders are not persisted between page navigations.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: Order state is in-memory only (React Context). Navigation clears the state.
findings.recommendation: Persist orders to localStorage or a backend API. At minimum, pass order data via router state to the confirmation page.

evidence.description: Order History shows empty state immediately after confirmed purchase

findings.title: Duplicate navigation links in header
findings.description: The navbar contains two separate "Home" links — the logo and an explicit "Home" nav item — creating confusion about which to use.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: Both the brand logo and a text link both route to "/".
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant "Home" text link. The logo serves this purpose.

evidence.description: Two elements link to "/" in the top navigation

reports.summary: The purchase journey has critical failures at the payment stage. The user cannot complete their primary goal. Navigation and search work correctly but the checkout flow has a silent failure that results in cart abandonment and an unexplained error state.

findings.title: Payment gateway timeout causes silent failure
findings.description: The payment endpoint times out 40% of the time and the user sees a blank error page with no explanation or retry option.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: POST /api/orders returns 500 with a gateway timeout error. INFERRED: The timeout threshold is set too low.
findings.recommendation: Add a payment retry mechanism and show a user-friendly error with options: retry, use another payment method, or save cart.

evidence.description: POST /api/orders returned HTTP 500 — gateway_timeout

findings.title: Login redirects to non-existent /dashboard route
findings.description: After successful login, users are redirected to /dashboard which does not exist, resulting in a 404 error.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: The login success redirect is hardcoded to /dashboard. INFERRED: This was not updated when the dashboard route was removed.
findings.recommendation: Change the post-login redirect to /products or the user's intended destination.

evidence.description: Expected redirect to /products, got /dashboard (404)

findings.title: No visual feedback when adding item to cart
findings.description: Clicking "Add to Cart" updates the cart count but shows no toast, animation, or confirmation. Users may click multiple times thinking the action failed.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: INFERRED: The addToCart function only logs to console, with no UI notification implemented.
findings.recommendation: Add a toast notification or cart flyout when an item is successfully added.

evidence.description: Cart badge updated but no feedback shown to user
console.log: "Item added to cart: ProBook Laptop"

findings.title: Order history always empty after purchase
findings.description: Immediately after placing an order, the Order History page shows "No orders yet" — orders are not persisted between page navigations.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: Order state is in-memory only (React Context). Navigation clears the state.
findings.recommendation: Persist orders to localStorage or a backend API. At minimum, pass order data via router state to the confirmation page.

findings.title: Duplicate navigation links in header
findings.description: The navbar contains two separate "Home" links — the logo and an explicit "Home" nav item — creating confusion about which to use.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: CONFIRMED: Both the brand logo and a text link both route to "/".
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant "Home" text link. The logo serves this purpose.
